caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with crisp menma and shredded cabbage. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a dark, textured surface under soft, warm lighting.

segments_info.text: Black textured table surface with subtle grain, oval shape, smooth finish, and faint light reflections.
The miso broth is creamy yellow, textured with bubbles and floating ingredients, showing surface tension and slight sheen.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous texture and subtle surface ridges.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, blue-rimmed edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slight yellow stain near tip.
